topic: Claiming got cheap. Checking did not.

items.prompt: In the 2023 study of chatbot-written literature reviews, what told the real references from the invented ones?

choices.text: The invented ones were formatted badly
The chatbot marked the ones it was unsure of

format.note: This assumes a made-up reference looks wrong. In the study the two looked the same on the page.

flag.note: This trusts the source to report on itself. Nothing in the output marked the invented works.

source.quote: On the page, the invented and the real look the same. Only the search told them apart.

items.prompt: Roughly what share of the GPT-3.5 references in that study did not exist?

fifth.note: About one in five is the figure for the newer model, GPT-4, in the same study.

few.note: Fluent, well-formed references are what the study checked, and many of them pointed at nothing.

source.quote: Fifty-five percent of the references from GPT-3.5 did not exist.

items.prompt: By reviewers' own reports, about how long does one peer review take?

minutes.note: This treats checking as a glance. The estimate rests on surveys of reviewers, who report much longer.

weeks.note: Weeks is how long a review can take to come back. The working time reviewers report is far shorter.

source.quote: one peer review takes about six hours of a skilled person's time.

items.prompt: What did the Twitter study of rumor cascades measure?

choices.text: That refuting a claim takes ten times the effort of making it
How far and how fast true and false stories spread

ratio.note: The ten-to-one line is an adage. No study in this film measures that ratio.

cost.note: The study timed how stories travelled between people. It put no price on checking them.

source.quote: That study measures spread, not cost.

items.prompt: When does checking a claim become cheap?

choices.text: When a better model made the claim
When the claim looks careful and well sourced
When the data travel with the claim, so anyone can rerun it

model.note: A better model makes claiming cheaper. The check still costs what it cost.

careful.note: How a claim looks says nothing about whether it holds, as the first chapter showed.

source.quote: When the data travel with the claim, a check becomes a rerun.
